QRADAR_SOAR_QUERY.description: Optional IBM QRadar SOAR (Resilient) incident filter forwarded to POST /rest/orgs/{id}/incidents/query_paged. Pass a JSON document representing an IncidentsQueryDTO (e.g. {"filters": [{"conditions": [{"field_name": "plan_status", "method": "equals", "value": "A"}]}]}), a bare filters list ([{"conditions": [...]}]), or a single condition object ({"field_name": "severity_code", "method": "gte", "value": 4}). The executor merges the value into the default payload, which sorts by create_date desc. Omit to pull every incident visible to the API key in the organization.

name: qradar_soar
title: IBM QRadar SOAR (Resilient)
description: IBM QRadar SOAR (formerly IBM Resilient) REST API importer. Pulls security incidents from a QRadar SOAR organization and maps them into Faraday vulnerabilities. Lists incidents via POST /rest/orgs/{org_id}/incidents/query_paged (paginated with start/length, optionally filtered by QRADAR_SOAR_QUERY as a Resilient IncidentsQueryDTO / filters / single condition document), then per-incident artifacts via GET /rest/orgs/{org_id}/incidents/{id}/artifacts to resolve the affected asset (IP address, DNS name, MAC, OS). Each incident is mapped to one Faraday host derived from those artifacts; incidents without a resolvable asset are attached to a synthetic 0.0.0.0 host so the data is still imported. Severity is normalised from Resilient's severity_code (4=High, 5=Medium, 6=Low default scale) with a fallback to the textual severity field when present and a final fallback to info. Status maps from plan_status (A=Active -> open, C=Closed -> closed) and is forced to closed when resolution_id is set; resolution_summary is surfaced as the Faraday resolution. CVE list is scraped from artifacts of type 'CVE' / 'Vulnerability' and from any custom incident property whose name contains 'cve'. Auth is HTTP Basic with QRADAR_SOAR_API_KEY_ID as username and QRADAR_SOAR_API_KEY_SECRET as password (standard Resilient API key); QRADAR_SOAR_HOST is the SOAR base URL.
